summary: iter132 — Verified Customer Expo app 4 new pages: Help & Support (list + new ticket + thread + close), Refer & Earn, AI Assistant (with session reuse), and Profile shortcuts. Backend pytest 9/9 PASS. Frontend end-to-end flows all pass including throwaway ticket create+message+close, referral code AZO0004 with copy toast + history rows, AI chat session_id echoed on second call, and profile shortcut navigation to addresses/orders.

backend_verified.GET /api/growth/referral: 200 · code AZO0004 returned for demo customer
backend_verified.POST /api/ai/chat: 200 · returns session_id on first call, echoes provided session_id on second call

frontend_verified.Support list: support-center + page-title 'Help & Support' + support-count '2 tickets · …' + support-new-btn + support-list-search filter works. Seed ticket support-ticket-TKT-100001 visible.
frontend_verified.New ticket validation: Empty subject → toast 'Please enter a subject'. Empty message → toast 'Please describe your issue'.
frontend_verified.New ticket create: support-submit → POST /support/tickets → auto opens support-thread. New ticket code TKT-100004 shown in info panel (info-code).
frontend_verified.Thread messaging: support-reply-input + support-send-btn → message 'Follow-up UI test message' appears in list (own bubble). Info panel support-ticket-info + info-code render.
frontend_verified.Close ticket: support-thread-menu → support-close-btn → support-close-dialog → support-close-confirm → support-closed-note appears, composer (support-reply-input) hidden. support-thread-back returns to support-center.
frontend_verified.Referral page: referral-page renders; referral-code = 'AZO0004' (matches spec). StatTiles ref-invited (3), ref-joined (3), ref-earned (₹100), ref-pending (₹200) all present. Share card + all buttons render: referral-card-image, share-whatsapp, share-native, share-download, card-copy-code, card-copy-link, copy-referral, copy-referral-link, share-referral. copy-referral shows 'Referral code copied!' toast. apply-code-input auto-uppercases 'zzzz9999' → 'ZZZZ9999'. referral-history has 3 referral-row-* rows.
frontend_verified.AI assistant: ai-page + ai-chat + initial ai-msg-assistant greeting render. Sending 'Hello from UI test' produced ai-msg-user bubble and POST /api/ai/chat (body without session_id) returned session_id. Second message 'Second question?' sent with session_id in body — session id reused correctly (verified via network request body).
frontend_verified.Profile shortcuts: profile-shortcuts row renders. shortcut-addresses navigates to /addresses → address-book visible. shortcut-orders navigates to /orders → orders-page visible. shortcut-wallet button also visible.

ui_bugs.issue: support-send-btn is NOT actually disabled (is_disabled()==false) when reply-input is empty — likely visually styled but missing HTMLButtonElement disabled prop. Spec says 'disabled when empty'.
apply-code-btn is NOT actually disabled (is_disabled()==false) when apply-code-input is empty — same styled-only disabled pattern. Spec says 'disabled when empty'.

action_items: (Optional) Set proper `disabled` attribute (not just styling) on support-send-btn and apply-code-btn so accessibility tools and Playwright's is_disabled() recognise the disabled state.

(Optional) Confirm that applying an invalid referral code shows a user-visible error toast on the Refer & Earn page — the network request went through but text scan didn't detect a clear 'Invalid code' message. Please inspect the toast text/copy manually.
critical_code_review_comments: SupportThread should mark support-send-btn with proper `disabled` prop (RN Pressable `disabled={!text.trim()}`), not just a styled dim state.
Referral apply-code-btn should similarly be truly disabled when the input is empty.

AI Assistant provider is not configured (as noted in the request); reply is a fixed Hinglish 'not configured' message — expected, but consider surfacing this state as an info banner in the UI so users know the assistant is in stub mode.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional acceptance IDs across all 4 pages; 2 low-priority disabled-prop misses noted.

seed_data_creation: Created 1 throwaway support ticket TKT-100004 via UI (subject 'TEST_iter132 throwaway UI', category booking, priority low). Closed it via UI close flow as instructed. TKT-100001 was NOT closed. No other persistent data was created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new customer pages (support, referral, ai, profile shortcuts) route correctly under Expo (customer) group as /support, /referral, /ai, /profile. Session cookies/tokens don't persist across separate browser_automation tool calls — do login (demo-customer) and all navigation in ONE script. AI chat provider not configured — assistant reply is stub 'AI assistant abhi configure nahi hua hai…', session_id still returned + reused.
